subject: executor: Use uint32 as element length in hash join v2 (#57458)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s hash join v2 row-table layout change switching var-len element/key-length headers from 8B (`uint64`) to 4B (`uint32`). Builder/probe/meta, `chunk.AppendCellFromRawData`, and `codec.SerializeKeys(KeepVarColumnLength)` are updated consistently, with added guards to fail fast if any element/key would exceed `math.MaxUint32`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in executor correctness/semantics/concurrency for the touched paths; later history shows follow-up perf/refine commits but no correctness fix indicating a latent bug here.
